verdict.rationale: Docs and hands-on reports confirm Claude Design generates multiple design directions, layouts, prototypes, and mockups from prompts (claude-design-docs-1/2/9, comm-6/16), and one user shipped a landing page from a prompt in a few hours. However, other hands-on accounts report underwhelming or 'boring' output on simple prompts and even call it 'useless' (comm-3, comm-9, comm-10), and generated code is described as unmaintainable (comm-15), indicating real quality variability rather than uniformly polished output. Missing for 10: consistent quality across varied prompt types, independent benchmarking beyond scattered anecdotes, and resolution of reported generation failures.
